<div class="matter-layout">

    <div class="matter-level"><span class="scale">~10<sup>-8</sup> cm</span><strong>atom</strong></div>

  </div>
  <div class="matter-summary">
    <p>Ordinary matter needs only two types of fundamental particles:</p>
    <p class="equation">quarks + electrons</p>
    <p>Both quarks and electrons are <strong>fermions</strong> with spin \(1/2\).</p>
    <p class="muted small">Composite protons and neutrons are also fermions.</p>
  </div>
